text: Inference Portal Debian Inference Portal A self-service portal for Debian contributors to access LLM inference. Manage your API keys and track your budget consumption. Login with Salsa Only Debian Developers and Debian Maintainers are granted access. Recent changes 2026-09-25 Added the scaleway/qwen3.8-27b model. Documentation: added a DebGPT configuration section and extended the sandboxing example 2026-09-23 The service was announced on debian-devel-announce : Debian Inference Portal announcement
